mentions.name: Sierra Previewer
mentions.description: A previewer for Sierra, an XML-based DSL for building Java Swing user interfaces. The tool lets developers preview declarative Swing UIs written in Sierra's XML syntax, built around Sierra's layout manager, which the comment author describes as the only sane layout manager for Swing they have worked with. (Sierra itself is by Greg Brown, not the comment author.)
mentions.source_excerpt: A previewer for Sierra which is an XML based DSL for Java Swing (not by me, but by Greg Brown)
